title: route B's uniform raster re-graded at C-0208's resolved per-bond link, and the flat count restated with the link stiffness attached
verificationType: logical (the link resolution is closed form and the bond census is exact integer lattice geometry) + in-silico (the same honeycomb grillage, the same T-299 tether element and the same T-307 per-turn spans -- only the link moves) + literature (C-0205's shear ceiling and C-0208's radial bracket, both re-derived here through the corpus's own functions rather than transcribed)
maturity: TRL 1-3. Model-consistent and traceable. NOT empirically demonstrated. The RADIAL constant is unsourceable (C-0208 section 6) and is carried as a bracket; the answer is stated at both of its ends and at a fourth rung below both. No such raster has been drawn, let alone folded.

units.dishing: dimensionless, as a fraction of the free stroke of the SAME lattice

conventions.the link: k_radial unitZ^2 + k_transverse unitY^2 on the bond's own line of centres (C-0208). An in-plane bond has unitZ = 0 and reads the transverse constant exactly; one through the thickness has unitZ^2 = 3/4
conventions.a null radial constant: the standing single-scalar object by IDENTITY, not by arithmetic -- unitY^2 + unitZ^2 is not exactly one in floating point
conventions.the free stroke: the mean deflection of the UNTIED lattice of the same row AT THE SAME RUNG under the uniform interior pressure. A uniform load translates a free tile rigidly, so it is link-independent, and the uniform-load dishing is emitted beside it
conventions.dishing: peakDishing(81) over that stroke; C-0167's convention, T-5b = 0.10
conventions.the lattice phase: b0, the class-zero staple residue, a free DESIGN VARIABLE on a raster that does not close

parameters.raster: uniform, route B -- the paired row is scaffoldNucleotides / 60 - 28
parameters.chainReadings: 28 nt at both rims (C-0193); C-0200's ordered split: 24 nt low, 32 high; C-0200's ordered split exchanged: 32 nt low, 24 high
parameters.rungs: the penalty (C-0207's own reading) (in plane 10000.0, through 10000.0); the resolved ceiling (in plane 254.808095, through 1365.32644); the resolved floor (in plane 254.808095, through 629.20588); the uniform shear ceiling (in plane 254.808095, through 254.808095)
parameters.subdivisions: 1 at every headline cell; 2 on the convergence axis
parameters.whyTheRegimeBlockIsNull: environment.Regime holds the gap and the bias as INTERVALS and refuses a degenerate one; this study solves no electrostatics, it reads ONE profile record of T-3b and uses it as a fixed load shape, so the state is a POINT (C-0181, CH-0224)

cheapBound.stage: 1 -- arithmetic on two committed result files, no solve
cheapBound.question: how much can a softer link raise a FREE-tile dishing on this cross-section, and can that reach T-5b from C-0207's own readings?
cheapBound.answer: C-0194 / T-297's committed six-decade link sweep carries a 10 x 6 free-tile row at THIS study's own enhancement, 21.1851817: it reads 0.0501417316 at the 1e4 penalty and 0.0524339812 at 41.4338953 pN/nm, an amplification of 1.04571541x -- and that rung is 6.14974995x BELOW the softest bond any rung of this study contains, so it is a deliberate over-estimate
cheapBound.consequence: a C-0207 cell can cross T-5b's 0.10 only if it reads above 0.0956283129. 0 of 756 do. The worst cell in C-0207's whole census, 0.0946863482, keeps 1.00994826x of slack against that threshold, so the PREDICTION recorded before the grading ran was: the count SURVIVES at 756 of 756

cheapBound.stage: 2 -- why the prediction is not a theorem
cheapBound.question: does the amplification transfer?
cheapBound.answer: no, and it is stated as a prediction for three reasons. T-297's sweep is read on the 116 bp block, not on 92 / 98 / 106 bp; it carries route-A TIES or none, not 59 tethers with a preload; and it is a UNIFORM link where this study's is per-bond, which is CH-0264's own trap
cheapBound.consequence: the uniform reading bounds the resolved one only if the dishing is monotone in the link, which is why the softest defensible lattice -- radial = transverse = the shear ceiling -- is graded as a fourth rung and monotonicity is MEASURED at the deciding cell (F6)

cheapBound.stage: 3 -- and why CH-0265's own direction does not settle it either
cheapBound.question: C-0205 section 4 reads 0 of 16 tethered cells flat with the p90 rising as the link softens. Why is that not the answer?
cheapBound.answer: because it is a COUPLED p90 under C-0087's measured staple dropout, over 4 000 realisations of a placement and a distribution, and this is the FREE tile. The two quantities differ by the whole coupling
cheapBound.consequence: the direction transfers in SIGN and its size does not, which is exactly what a re-grade measures. C-0207 section 7's coupled reading at these widths is still open and still needs a placement search

findings: C-0207'S 756 OF 756 SURVIVES THE RESOLVED PER-BOND LINK, AND THE COUNT IS NOW QUOTED WITH THE LINK STIFFNESS ATTACHED. At C-0208's resolved link -- 254.808095 pN/nm at the 108 to 135 in-plane bonds and 629.20588 to 1365.32644 pN/nm at the 250 to 275 that run through the thickness -- route B's three uniform paired rows read 0.048606444 to 0.0960647281 of the stroke over 2268 cells, 2268 of them flat against T-5b's 0.10, where C-0207 read 0.0483790868 to 0.0946863482 at the penalty and this study reproduces all 756 of its cells at a worst departure of 0.0.

THE LINK IS WORTH AT MOST 1.02460822x OF THE READING, AND THE CHEAP BOUND SAID SO WITH NO SOLVE. The prediction recorded before the grading section ran was the count SURVIVES at 756 of 756, from one division on C-0194 / T-297's committed free-tile link sweep: the largest amplification six decades of link can produce on this cross-section is 1.04571541x, so nothing below 0.0956283129 can reach T-5b, and C-0207's worst cell is 0.0946863482. Measured, the amplification is 1.02460822x at its worst and the softest defensible lattice -- every bond at the shear ceiling -- reads 0.0960647281 at its worst cell. F8 did not fire.
